attributes.name: Product Series
attributes.description: Manufacturer's series or family designation only, without the word "series" and without the manufacturer name. The anchor for part-number grammar induction, because the positional encoding of a smart part number is defined per series rather than per manufacturer.

attributes.name: Nominal Pipe Size
attributes.description: Nominal pipe size of the valve end connections, as designated by the manufacturer. Expressed as NPS in imperial markets and DN in metric markets. This is a designation, not a measured bore diameter.

attributes.name: Pressure Rating (WOG)
attributes.description: Maximum non-shock working pressure for water, oil and gas service at ambient temperature. WOG is a rating class, not a unit. Capture the reference temperature separately if the source states one.

attributes.name: Body Material
attributes.description: Primary material of the valve body casting or forging. Capture the specific alloy designation when the source gives one, because lead content and pressure rating both depend on the exact alloy rather than the material family.

allowed_values.note: leaded alloy - incompatible with a lead-free claim
leaded alloy - incompatible with a lead-free claim

attributes.name: End Connection
attributes.description: Connection style at the valve ends. NPT and BSPT are NOT interchangeable and must never be normalized into one another; they are both tapered pipe threads with similar nominal designations and they do not seal against each other.

attributes.name: Stem Material
attributes.description: Material of the valve stem. Relevant to dezincification resistance and to potable-water compliance.

allowed_values.note: common gate-valve stem alloy; dezincification resistant

attributes.name: Handle Type
attributes.description: Handle style supplied with this specific part number. Frequently varies by size within one series, so read the ordering-table row rather than the general specification block, and check footnotes for size-dependent substitutions.

attributes.name: Temperature Range
attributes.description: Minimum and maximum service temperature. Bounded by the weakest component, usually the seat rather than the body.

attributes.name: Steam Pressure Rating (WSP)
attributes.description: Maximum working steam pressure. Distinct from and lower than the WOG rating. Reporting the WOG figure here is a common and consequential extraction error.

attributes.name: Flow Coefficient (Cv)
attributes.description: Valve flow coefficient Cv, the flow in US gallons per minute of 60F water that produces a one PSI pressure drop. Dimensionless by convention. Size-dependent, so read the value for the target SKU's size.

attributes.name: Lead-Free Compliant
attributes.description: True only when the source explicitly references a lead-free certification or declaration such as NSF/ANSI 372, or the Safe Drinking Water Act weighted-average lead content requirement. A lead-free claim may never be inferred from the product family, the series name, or the presence of other certifications.

attributes.name: Potable Water Approved
attributes.description: True only when the source references an NSF/ANSI 61 certification for drinking-water system components. Do not infer from a lead-free claim; they are different standards covering different things.

attributes.name: Approvals and Listings
attributes.description: Third-party certifications, listings and approvals explicitly stated in the source. Record only what is stated. A listing number without a recognised mark is not an approval, and an approval for one size in a series does not extend to the others.

attributes.name: Country of Origin
attributes.description: Country where the product is manufactured, as stated by the manufacturer. Drives tariff treatment and trade-agreement eligibility, so a guess here has direct financial consequences.

attributes.name: GTIN / UPC
attributes.description: Global Trade Item Number, 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits. The final digit is a modulo-10 check digit, which L0 validation verifies arithmetically — a transposed digit is therefore detectable without any external lookup.

attributes.name: Weight (Each)
attributes.description: Shipping weight of a single unit. Distinguish carefully from carton weight; datasheets often place them in adjacent columns with similar headings.

attributes.name: Carton Quantity
attributes.description: Number of selling units per carton or master pack for this specific part number. Frequently varies by size within one series, so read the ordering-table row that matches the target SKU.

attributes.name: Selling Unit of Measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the product is sold, which is not necessarily the unit in which it is priced or stocked. Conflating the three is a classic source of order errors.
